newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kwoon Chung to issue 35.2 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Kwoon Chung to issue 35.2 mln new shares.

text.p: Kwoon Chung Bus Holdings Ltd said on Thursday its majority shareholder planned to place 35.2 million existing shares at HK$3.0 each, and to subscribe to the same number of new shares at the same price.

Kwoon Chung said in a statement 57.1-percent shareholder Wong Family Holdings Ltd had agreed to subscribe to 35.2 million new shares at HK$3.0 each, a discount of about 8.5 percent to the HK$3.28 average closing price over the previous 10 days.
It said Kim Eng Securities (Hong Kong) Ltd was underwriting the placement by Wong Family Holdings of the same number of existing shares at the same price.
Proceeds from the issue would be used for working capital, and expansion in Hong Kong and China, it said.
The Hong Kong-based bus line operator said the new shares represented about 14.19 percent of its existing capital, and 12.43 percent of its enlarged capital.
After the April 7 placement of existing shares, Wong Family Holdings' Kwoon Chung Stake would shrink to 42.9 percent, rising to 50 percent on subscription to the new shares, it said.
If Wong Family Holdings exercised share options over Kwoon Chung, it would hold 51.25 percent of its enlarged capital, the company said. -- Hong Kong newsroom (852) 2843 6370
